description: This Java class 'EmployeeDBUtil' provides database utility functions for managing Employee objects, including validation, retrieval, insertion, updating, and deletion of employee data in the database. It interacts with SQL queries and handles different employee roles like Manager and DeliveryPerson.

classes.name: EmployeeDBUtil
classes.description: A utility class for database operations related to Employee, including login validation, CRUD operations, and role-based object instantiation.

methods.name: validateEmployee
methods.description: Validates an employee credentials by email and password against the database.

methods.name: getAllEmployees
methods.description: Retrieves all employees with their associated roles and details from the database, creating appropriate Employee, Manager, or DeliveryPerson objects.

methods.name: insertEmployee
methods.description: Inserts a new employee record into the database with provided details.

methods.name: updateEmployee
methods.description: Updates the employee's email, phone, image URL, and password based on employee ID.

methods.name: deleteEmployee
methods.description: Deletes an employee from the database based on employee ID.

methods.name: updateEmployeeWithoutImage
methods.description: Updates an employee's email, phone, and password without changing the image, based on employee ID.
